adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review completed. Local material supports the paper as an E. coli K-12 genome-sequence correction article, not a source-supported AMP assay paper. No activity/toxicity rows were fabricated; linked DRAMP/dbAMP AMP labels remain conflict/database-only provenance, and the paper stays non-accepted.

materials_exhausted.notes: Bounded local recovery checked source XML/PDF, OA package members, extracted PDF text, DOC/PDF/XLS supplements, HTML landing assets, locator index, and linked database snapshots. No source-supported AMP activity/toxicity/mechanism row was recoverable.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: The DOI/PMID literature link is real, but DRAMP/dbAMP AMP identity/activity labels are not source-verified by the primary paper; six linked rows remain source_conflict and one dbAMP row remains database_only_no_primary_source.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: No primary source-supported endpoint/raw value/unit/target rows were recoverable from XML/PDF/prose/figures/supplements or linked assay snapshots; activity_records is intentionally empty.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: No AMP mechanism claim is source-supported in the selected paper; automated mechanism locator notes were removed from final claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_6_adjudication: Publication-grade acceptance is refused because the missing activity layer is a true local-material gap rather than an extractable value.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Linked database annotations are preserved as provenance but are not promoted to primary-source activity or sequence verification.
The local primary and supplementary material does not contain AMP assay values; the semantic gate will continue to fail missing_activity_records by design.

qc_failure_reasons.reason: Bounded source review found no local primary activity/toxicity assay rows; no endpoint/raw value/unit/target row can be created without fabricating unsupported values.

Linked DRAMP/dbAMP rows associate Cas2/antimicrobial/antiviral labels with this citation, but local primary material does not support AMP identity, assay values, or target-organism activity for those rows.
